verdict.line: You lose levels 1–5 outright, and you win everything after 15 minutes.

brief.thesis: Renekton is one of the hardest early lane bullies in the game and Sett is one of the better late-game bruisers, so this lane is entirely about surviving levels 1–5. The saving grace is that Sett's W converts damage taken into grit while Renekton's all-in is front-loaded burst — his combo literally loads your gun. Most Setts lose this matchup by trying to trade first instead of letting him commit and W'ing back.

theirWindow.what: Empowered W stuns and deals bonus max-health damage. Do not be in range. Back off, farm under tower, and let him shove the wave.

yourWindow.what: He is one of the weakest champions in the game for those few seconds. Every trade and every all-in you take happens inside this window.

boots.why: Buy early, sometimes before a first item component. All his damage is physical

Bonus health, and the shield covers the exact window his burst would kill you in

he got ahead anyway and is bursting you down

runes.keystoneWhy: Lane survivability beats the Conqueror scaling you won't live long enough to use before 6

summoners.why: Ghost only if you're confident you'll be ahead. At level 3, you usually won't be.

playing.title: Let him commit first
playing.detail: Eat the E-W, bank the grit, then W the true damage back into him. Land the centre of the cone, not the edge.

playing.title: Hold E until his dashes are gone
playing.detail: Facebreaker is your only hard CC and he will simply E away from it. Use it once both charges are spent, to guarantee the W.

playing.title: Ult him through his own R
playing.detail: Show Stopper scales off the target's bonus health and Dominus hands him a large chunk of it. His ultimate being up is a reason to commit, not to back off — as long as his Fury is spent.

playing.title: Suppression beats his escape
playing.detail: Once Show Stopper lands, his E cannot get him out of it. That is your kill window at 6.

playing.title: Lose the wave on purpose
playing.detail: He shoves with Q, so let him. Farm under tower and don't contest a wave you don't need. Every minute you deny him a kill moves the game toward the half you win.

brief.patchCaveat: The matchup logic here is stable across patches. Item names and rune numbers drift — sanity-check the exact list against the live patch.
